The Section on the Past and Future (Atītānāgatavāra)
10.3.6.1. Positive Order (Anuloma) He who has fully understood the eye-faculty will abandon the faculty of mental distress? No.
Or else, he who will abandon the faculty of mental distress has fully understood the eye-faculty? No.
Is it the case that whoever has fully understood the eye-faculty will cultivate the faculty of "I shall come to know the unknown"? No.
Or rather, is it the case that whoever will cultivate the faculty of "I shall come to know the unknown" has fully understood the eye-faculty? No.
Is it the case that whoever has fully understood the eye-faculty will cultivate the faculty of final knowledge? No.
Or, whoever will develop the faculty of final knowledge (aññindriya), has he already fully understood the faculty of the eye (cakkhundriya)? No.
Whoever has already fully understood the faculty of the eye, will he realize the faculty of one who has already known (aññātāvindriya)? No.
Or, whoever will realize the faculty of one who has already known, has he already fully understood the faculty of the eye? No. (Based on the faculty of the eye.)
Is it the case that whoever has abandoned the faculty of mental distress will cultivate the faculty of "I shall come to know the unknown"? No.
Or rather, is it the case that whoever will cultivate the faculty of "I shall come to know the unknown" has abandoned the faculty of mental distress? No.
Is it the case that whoever has abandoned the faculty of mental distress will cultivate the faculty of final knowledge (*aññindriya*)? No.

Two persons have abandoned the faculty of mental grief (*domanassindriya*), but they will not cultivate the faculty of final knowledge (*aññindriya*). A non-returner (*anāgāmī*) has abandoned the faculty of mental grief and will also cultivate the faculty of final knowledge.
Or, conversely, whoever will cultivate the faculty of final knowledge, has that person abandoned the faculty of mental grief?

Six persons will cultivate the faculty of final knowledge, but they have not abandoned the faculty of mental grief. A non-returner will cultivate the faculty of final knowledge and has abandoned the faculty of mental grief.

10.3.6.2. Negative (Paccanīka)
Is it the case that whoever has not fully understood the faculty of the eye will not abandon the faculty of mental grief?

Five types of persons have not fully understood the faculty of the eye, yet they will not fail to abandon the faculty of mental grief. Four types of persons have neither fully understood the faculty of the eye nor will they abandon the faculty of mental grief.
Or conversely, is it the case that whoever will not abandon the faculty of mental grief has not fully understood the faculty of the eye?

An Arahant will not abandon the faculty of mental grief, but he has not failed to fully understand the faculty of the eye. There are four types of persons who will neither abandon the faculty of mental grief nor have they fully understood the faculty of the eye.
Is it the case that whoever has not fully understood the faculty of the eye will not cultivate the faculty of "I shall come to know the unknown"?
Those worldlings who will attain the path have not fully understood the faculty of the eye, but they are not [persons who] will not cultivate the faculty of "I shall come to know the unknown."

They will not cultivate it. There are eight persons who have not fully understood the eye-faculty (*cakkhundriya*) and will not cultivate the "I-shall-come-to-know-the-unknown" faculty (*anaññātaññassāmītindriya*).
Or rather, is it the case that whoever will not cultivate the "I-shall-come-to-know-the-unknown" faculty has not fully understood the eye-faculty?

An Arhat will not cultivate the "I-shall-come-to-know-the-unknown" faculty, yet he has not failed to fully understand the eye-faculty. There are eight persons who will not cultivate the "I-shall-come-to-know-the-unknown" faculty and have not fully understood the eye-faculty.

Or, conversely, he who will not develop the faculty of final knowledge has not fully understood the faculty of the eye?
